defs.def: the money that you spend on sth 费用；价钱

ex.s: I know from experience that Dr Nobel occupied himself with the solution of medical problems and that he spared neither trouble nor expense to obtain an explanation of the question raised.
ex.t: 根据我的经验，我知道诺贝尔博士致力于解决医学问题，而且为了获取所提出问题的解释，他既不惜工夫，也不吝费用。

ex.s: Too often, when you stand up to give a speech, you focus on the “public” at the expense of the “speaking.”    17     Focus on the speaking.
ex.t: 很多时候，当你站起来演讲时，你只顾着“公众”而牺牲了“演讲”。    17     把注意力放在演讲上。

defs.def: something that makes you spend money 花钱的东西；开销

ex.s: She never minded the alarm clock sounding at 4 am or questioned my expenses on running.
ex.t: 她从不介意凌晨4点的闹钟响起，也不质疑我在跑步上的开销。

ex.s: But it all depends on my expenses, so I intend to find some work first.
ex.t: 但这完全取决于我的开销，所以我打算先找份工作。
他们支付她所有的开销。

defs.def: money spent in doing a particular job, or for a particular purpose 开支；花费；费用

ex.t: 它可能会增加日常开支。

ex.s: How to cut his travel expenses.
ex.t: 如何削减他的差旅费用。

defs.def: money that you spend while you are working and which your employer will pay back to you later （向雇主报销的）费用，开支，花销，业务费用

ex.s: And his dad, Albert, took the money my dad earned and used it to pay family expenses.
ex.t: 而他的爸爸，阿尔伯特，拿走了我爸挣来的钱，用它来支付家庭开支。

ex.s: With food our biggest weekly household expense, Susanna and Matt spend time with a different family each week.
ex.t: 由于食物是我们每周最大的家庭开支，苏珊娜和马特每周与一户不同的家庭共度时光。

ex.s: Tuition fees and living expenses are much more expensive than at home and could end up costing most families an arm and a leg.
ex.t: 学费和生活费比在国内贵得多，最后可能会让大多数家庭花掉一大笔钱。

ex.s: Whether you’re looking at wallpaper or paint, the time, effort and relative expense put into it are significant.
ex.t: 无论你是看壁纸还是油漆，投入的时间、精力和相对成本都是相当可观的。

defs.def: paid for by sb 由某人付钱；由某人负担费用
if you make a joke at sb's expense, you laugh at them and make them feel silly 在某人受损的情况下；以某人为代价；跟某人开玩笑

ex.s: Instead, I agree with Oxford University philosopher Nick Bostrom, who believes that the heaviest risks from A GI do not come from a decision to turn against mankind but rather from a dogged pursuit of set objectives at the expense of everything else.
ex.t: 相反，我同意牛津大学哲学家尼克·博斯特罗姆的观点，他相信GI带来的最重风险并非来自对全人类的背叛，而是来自于以牺牲其他一切为代价，对既定目标的顽强追求。

ex.s: Some companies are taking unfair advantage of this situation to expand their share of the market, often at the expense of more traditional and established companies.
ex.t: 一些公司正在不公平地利用这一情况来扩大自己的市场份额，往往是以牺牲更传统、更成熟的公司为代价的。

ex.s: All this technology does not come at the expense of fashion.
ex.t: 所有这些技术并没有以牺牲时尚为代价。
